name: Viewer reads available actions
description: You are acting as Iris Novak (user-view-1), a viewer on Project Alpha. List what actions are available to you, then use your read access to search for all open issues and retrieve the details of any issue you find.

name: Cannot close sprint with open P1
description: Sprint 'Sprint 6' is active and contains a P1 issue 'Data loss bug' that is still open. Try to close the sprint — this should fail. Then resolve and close the P1 issue, and close the sprint successfully.

name: Cannot self-approve PR
description: Issue 'My feature' is in_review and assigned to you (Carol Reyes, user-mgr-1). You cannot approve your own PR. Find another reviewer — have someone else (the system will handle the acting user) approve it. Since you ARE the assignee, the approve should fail. Then reassign the issue to Eve Park (user-dev-1) so someone else can own it, and approve it yourself.

name: Cannot modify locked issue
description: Issue 'Frozen requirement' is locked. Try to change its priority to P1 — this should fail. Then unlock it (you are Carol Reyes, a manager) and change its priority to P1.

name: Cannot close project with active sprints
description: Project Alpha has an active sprint. Try to close the project — it should fail. Close the sprint first, then close the project.

name: Invalid status transition
description: Issue 'New feature' is open. Try to transition it directly to 'resolved' — this should fail because the valid path is open→in_progress→in_review→resolved. Follow the correct transition path to get it to resolved.

name: Cannot add issue to closed sprint
description: Sprint 'Closed Sprint' is already closed. Try to add the open issue 'Late addition' to it — this should fail. Create a new sprint, activate it, and add the issue there instead.

name: Developer cannot delete project
description: You are acting as Eve Park (user-dev-1), a developer. Try to close Project Alpha — this should fail because only admins and managers can close projects. Verify the project is still active.
